ANDRITZ Pumps is a leading manufacturer of centrifugal pumps with a broad, competitive product and application portfolio and global manufacturing and sales presence. Our main manufacturing locations are found in Austria, China, India, and Brazil. We develop, manufacture, and distribute pumps that are engineered and built for a single project as well as standard pumps that are based on a modular system. 

To fulfil our demanding delivery time goals for the European and African Market, we carry a significant stock of parts in Graz, that are used both for Service and Assembly of new Pumps.

In our Pumps Division in Graz, we are looking for 1 Senior MRP Controller & Inventory Manager (m/f/d) You will be responsible for operative stock management and stock management strategy for centrifugal pumps as well as active management of net working capital.

Your Tasks

You will be responsible for the entire material planning process and material availability. As part of ongoing demand planning, you review the demand and inventory status of the planned materials, make any necessary adjustments, and ensure the availability of materials for the production process.

 * Responsibility for maintaining the material master data (MRP) relevant for scheduling and planning requisitions to ensure optimal supply for assembly

 * Interface with purchasing, plant, quality department, internal production facilities, suppliers, etc.

 * Creating and releasing requirements

 * Creating planning and releasing order requisitions 

 * Check material availability in the course of scheduling 

 * Model management for casting models 

 * Continuous monitoring of inventory turnover time and active management of stock value based on the monitoring 

Are You Our Ideal Candidate?

 * Completed commercial or technical training (HAS, HAK, HTL), university degree advantageous.

 * Professional Background in requisition planning and execution essential. This includes especially the theory, practical application and handling in IT Systems of:

 ** SAP operative expert user

 ** ABC XYZ Analysis

 ** Disposition Parameters including Safety Stock, Reorder Point, Optimal Reorder Quantity

 ** Understanding of complex bill of materials with multi-level structure and variances

 * Knowledge of pumps and the pump industry would be preferred, or of comparable products

 * Enthusiasm for technical contexts

 * Proficient MS Office skills (especially MS Excel)

 * Languages: proficient German and English

 * Strong teamwork and (intercultural) communication skills

Our offer

 * An interesting position in an established corporate environment with the opportunity to actively shape your professional future

 * A great group of highly professional colleagues and management

 * Talent & leadership programs

 * Flexible working time model

 * Home office option

 * Various employee discounts

 * Subsidized company restaurant

 * Parking spaces & public accessibility

 * Bike Leasing

In Austria we are legally obliged to announce at least a gross monthly salary of € 3.802,93 for this position.

Depending on qualifications and professional experience we offer you a market-based salary. 

We pursue a policy of equal rights and opportunities and do not discriminate against any applicants on the basis of gender, ethnic origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability or other protected characteristics. We promote diversi-ty and equal opportunities and place exclusive emphasis on your qualifications, experience and skills that are rele-vant to the advertised position.

Contact partner: Caterina Hoeller

Every day, ANDRITZ continues to deliver successful innovative solutions to our customers globally. Why are we so successful? Because we are passionate and love what we do! We are at the forefront of future engineering technologies, with solutions that ensure the success of our clients in key industries that are shaping the future of the world we live in.

We are looking for a Head of Division and Project Supply Chain Management (m/f/d) in Graz or Vienna. 1 Head of Division and Project Supply Chain Management (m/f/d) Your Tasks

 * Develop and implement, together with your business partners and your team, supply chain strategies for complex capital projects and divisional portfolios.

 * Own end-to-end supply chain performance, ensuring seamless integration of sourcing, logistics execution, and supplier quality across all project phases.

 * Lead and further develop the Division and Project Supply Chain team with a clear focus on accountability, execution excellence, and performance ownership.

 * Ensure material availability, reliable logistics execution, and adherence to quality and delivery commitments across all project milestones.

 * Establish and govern supplier performance frameworks, including quality, delivery reliability, and risk management across the supply base.

 * Collaborate closely with project management, engineering, quality, logistics, and global SCM structures to ensure aligned execution.

 * Drive strategic sourcing, bundling initiatives, and continuous improvement with full responsibility for total cost, quality, and delivery performance (TCO view).

 * Implement ESG requirements and ensure compliance across suppliers, logistics partners, and the broader supply ecosystem.

 * Take ownership of supplier-related risks, escalations, and quality topics, ensuring structured mitigation and sustainable resolution.

 * Oversee contract negotiations and claim management in coordination with Legal, including commercial and quality-related claims.

 * Drive digitalization and automation across supply chain processes to improve transparency, efficiency, and real-time performance steering (incl. logistics & supplier KPIs).

 * Promote harmonization of supply chain processes across divisions and projects to ensure consistency and scalability.

 * Implement international best practices in strategic sourcing, supplier quality governance, logistics excellence, and KPI-driven performance monitoring.

 * Benchmark supply chain performance against global standards to identify improvement opportunities and ensure operational excellence.

 * Shape a resilient supply chain setup, integrating sourcing, logistics strategies, and supplier development to respond effectively to global disruptions and market dynamics.

Your Profile

 * University degree in business, engineering, or equivalent.

 * Strong project experience in plant engineering (Anlagenbau) and complex capital projects.

 * Several years of experience in supply chain management, ideally in an international industrial environment.

 * Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt beneficial.

 * Proven leadership experience and strong people management skills.

 * Expertise in demand planning, procurement, logistics, and end-to-end supplier performance and quality management.

 * Solid understanding of supplier quality governance, audit processes, and logistics concepts in project environments.

 * Strategic thinking and ability to align supply chain with business objectives.

 * Strong negotiation and contract management skills.

 * Excellent English skills; additional languages are an advantage.

 * Proficiency in SAP and common SCM tools.
